definitions.gloss: to arrange, to put in order

definitions.explanation: To bring together a complete set.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揃|そろ}える。
⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揃|そろ}える。
⟦{必要|ひつよう}な→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揃|そろ}えた。
⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揃|そろ}えて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please arrange your shoes neatly before entering the house.

notes:
{揃|そろ}える means to arrange neatly or gather together.

TRANSITIVITY PAIR:
- {揃|そろ}える (transitive): to arrange, gather
- {揃|そろ}う (intransitive): to be complete, be aligned

COMMON USES:
- {靴|くつ}を{揃|そろ}える: to arrange shoes neatly
- {材料|ざいりょう}を{揃|そろ}える: to gather ingredients
- {足並|あしな}みを{揃|そろ}える: to get in step
- {息|いき}を{揃|そろ}える: to synchronize breathing
- {条件|じょうけん}を{揃|そろ}える: to meet all conditions

CONJUGATION (ichidan):
- {揃|そろ}えない (negative)
- {揃|そろ}えて (te-form)
- {揃|そろ}えた (past)

CULTURE:
Arranging shoes neatly when entering a home is important Japanese etiquette.
